headline: Guinea Gold Export Rules Force Miners to Stockpile Bullion and Spark Crackdown
summary: Guinea's local refining rules requiring miners to keep more gold wealth at home are causing export bottlenecks, forcing major producers to stockpile bullion worth tens of millions. Concurrently, authorities sentenced over 220 people in a crackdown on illegal gold mining.
why: Changes to mineral export and refining regulations impact working capital for international mining companies and global bullion supply chains.

impacts.name: Gold
impacts.why: Export restrictions and refining mandates restrict raw bullion shipments, altering local supply flows.
